change: U6/U7 orderable changed to LT1963AEQ#TRPBF C459702 (same device and land, reel packing). U8 changed from out-of-stock fixed LT3015EQ-12#PBF C666307 to adjustable LT3015EQ#PBF C666306 on the same DD-Pak land; pin 4 becomes ADJ with a new R26/R27/R28 divider.
copper_changes: Removed the 0.4 mm F.Cu U8 pin 4 to pin 5 tie.
Added 0.25 mm F.Cu U8 ADJ from pin 4 leftward under the lead shoulders, up x=80.5 mm to the R27/R28 node.
Added 0.25 mm F.Cu sense from R26 pad 1 directly into the U8 pin 5 pad, and the R26-R27 series link.
R28 pad 2 joins the F.Cu ground pour; two pad-less ground-pour islands enclosed by the ADJ track were removed by the zone filler.
All other footprints, tracks, vias, zones outlines, outline and silkscreen are unchanged; B.Cu is untouched.
open: Output accuracy, loop stability with the divider, low-line headroom under ripple and thermal behaviour are unmeasured. The resistors sit about 5 mm from U8 and share its heating; only the 25 ppm/C TCR allowance covers that.
later_silkscreen_only_edit: 2026-09-21: reference designators tidied, P1 ATT/PDOK labels repositioned and -12 V marker rectangles added over J10/J11 pins 1-2 on both silkscreen layers; every non-silkscreen board element compared identical to 176fe973ff5f6493...
led2_polarity_correction: 2026-09-21: the JLCPCB placement preview showed LED2 (KT-0603YG C2289) with its anode on the GND pad. The imported symbol numbered pin 1 = anode, but the LCSC/EasyEDA library entry for C2289 and the blue/red LEDs use pin 1 = cathode on pad 1. Symbol pins were renumbered, LED2.1 moved to GND and LED2.2 to Net-(R7-LED2), and the footprint turned 180 degrees (CPL 90 -> 270). Pad positions, sizes and nets are unchanged; the courtyard outline was shifted 0.1 mm to the region it occupied before.
